title: Nana's Place in Music City
description:
NANA’S PLACE – You will be so glad that you chose to stay with us! Why would you stay in a hotel when you can make yourself at home at Nana’s Place?  No matter if you are in Music City for work or play, Nana’s Place is the perfect place for you. Close enough to the city to be convenient but far enough out to be safe and peaceful. Enjoy our "good ole" Southern Hospitality at Nana’s Place. Forget your worries in this spacious and serene place.

The space
You will feel at home in this spacious apartment. If you need to chill or even get in a little extra work, you will have a quiet and comfortable place to do it. 

Enjoy the best sleep you have ever had, linger in the hot shower, and feel free to prepare your favorite foods. 

You may even want to relax with a book (all have a Nashville connection) or play a game. And, of course you have a long list of viewing options with our Roku TV and Free Wi-Fi. 

In the winter months, you can enjoy setting by the fireplace. When it's a bit warmer, you can explore the wooded backyard or enjoy a cup of java on the patio.

Guest access
You are welcome to park just outside your door in the driveway, enjoy the back yard and patio, and take a walk through the neighborhood (vey safe). Please do not go onto the deck (above the patio).

Other things to note
Check in on Sunday is 6:00 PM.
Free shuttle to and from the airport with advance arrangements.
